verdict.rationale: Datadog ships datadog-ci, an official CLI (datadog-probe-4) plus CI Visibility docs (datadog-docs-25) and a full REST API (datadog-docs-24), enabling headless/CI automation of test visibility, uploads, and monitoring config. However, evidence doesn't show a unified 'headless agent' story for AI-native automation beyond CI test reporting and API calls. missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification of datadog-ci in real CI pipelines, documentation of full headless workflows beyond CI visibility (e.g., scripted dashboard/monitor management end-to-end), and community corroboration of automation reliability.
